announcements.headline: Audited Results for the year ended 30 June 2026
announcements.insight: Helium One Group Ltd reports audited results for the year ended 30 June 2026. This follows recent commercial milestones and a capital raise.

announcements.headline: Operational Update
announcements.insight: Helium One Group Ltd raised £3 million via a placing to fund project updates following earlier sales and an extended offtake agreement. This capital injection supports ongoing commercial operations.

announcements.headline: Placing to Raise £3 million and Project Updates
announcements.insight: Helium One Group Ltd raises £3 million via placing. This follows commercial milestones including first sales and an extended offtake agreement in July and September.

announcements.headline: Helium Offtake Agreement Extended Through Q1 2027
announcements.insight: The extension of the helium offtake agreement through Q1 2027 confirms ongoing commercial activity following initial sales in July and August.

announcements.headline: Further Sale Under Helium Offtake Agreement
announcements.insight: Helium One Group Ltd continues its commercialization of the Galactica Project through further sales under the existing Offtake Agreement. This follows the initial sale in July.

announcements.headline: First Sale Under Helium Offtake Agreement
announcements.insight: First helium sold from Pinon Canyon Plant follows the June Helium Offtake Agreement. This validates commercial execution of the Galactica Project strategy.

announcements.headline: First Helium Sold from Pinon Canyon Plant
announcements.insight: Helium One Group Ltd has sold its first helium from the Pinon Canyon Plant. This follows the earlier Galactica Project offtake agreement in June 2026.

announcements.headline: Gasworld Webinar
announcements.insight: Helium One Group Ltd is hosting a webinar following its June 2026 gas offtake agreement. Shareholders should watch for commercial updates regarding the Galactica Project.

announcements.headline: Helium Offtake Agreement for Galactica Project
announcements.insight: Helium One Group Ltd has entered an offtake agreement for its Galactica Project. This establishes a commercial pathway for production without disclosed financial terms.
